description: This Swift source file defines the `CanvasManager` class, which manages the lifecycle and interactions with a canvas panel within the application. It handles displaying, hiding, and navigating the canvas, as well as observing gateway updates and auto-navigating to web UI targets. It also includes functionalities like evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and updating debug status.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing canvas window sessions, including showing, hiding, evaluating scripts, and handling gateway updates for a macOS application.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the canvas session with a specific session key and optional path, returning the directory path.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Prepares and displays a detailed view of the canvas, optionally navigating to a specific target and placement, returning a `CanvasShowResult` object.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the canvas session with the specified session key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript string within a specified canvas session asynchronously.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current canvas view and saves it to the specified output path.

methods.name: refreshDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status display based on current app state and connection mode.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the A2UI host URL from raw gateway data asynchronously.

methods.name: makeShowResult
methods.description: Constructs a `CanvasShowResult` object representing the outcome of a show operation.

methods.name: localStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a local session based on the presence of index files or specific paths.
